mostWorthwhile.text: Reusing iron in the marrow was most worthwhile: it connected the breakdown of old red cells to the oxygen-carrying protein in new ones.

leastWorthwhile.text: Growing the skin cells was straightforward and predictable from the picture, though it clearly showed replacement.

surprise.text: I was interested that the marrow and its stem cells remained in place while new red cells entered the blood.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary; the pictures and chapter description explained both pairings.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how other body parts replace themselves, although this chapter's combinations were fairly predictable.
